limits.index: GitHub code search, literal (quoted) queries: absence claims are scoped to the indexed surface — unindexed repos cannot answer
limits.verification: every idl candidate (max 5/program) fetched; ok = the file really contains the literal; binding from the file itself
limits.premise: local git grep against the foreign clone at HEAD; trace-only is verified, not assumed
limits.indexHits: code/doc hits are index evidence only; only .json candidates are content-verified
